{"artifact":"SmeDossierEnvelope","schema_version":"0.4.0","stage_id":"02.dossier_sections","probe":"rdmv-hi-x","lineage":{"input_manifest_sha256":"af58aba4655398f1f00895d7024a20f6ffca923aa7d0da7b02cc7cbeef53476b","candidate_lineage_id":"2026-10-28-rdmv-hi-class-3:lineage:107","source_registry_sha256":"1323c0f691f132d6e9e9a263c68306b972b82c8bbaa5a48a33a79177660764be","source_liveness_sha256":"27cf6d56fae2d5323c61bcbb69f0d992aeceb71a7dae4302b1f14baa17651cb0"},"envelope_scope":{"kind":"partial_chunk","assigned_section_ids":["C2"],"chunk_index":1,"chunk_total":1},"section_char_limit":12000,"sections":[{"section_id":"C2","chunk_id":"C2.01","merge_seq":1,"domain":"Crash Procedures, Safety Responsibility Law and Motor Vehicle Insurance","heading":"C2 — KG hints for Crash Procedures, Safety Responsibility Law and Motor Vehicle Insurance","learner_facing":false,"markdown":"## C2 — KG hints for Crash Procedures, Safety Responsibility Law and Motor Vehicle Insurance

FACT_ID: sec10-R01 | anchor: A01
A crash must be reported to police at three thousand dollars or more of property damage [A01], while medical bills exceeding five thousand dollars permit a bodily-injury lawsuit [A03].
Why it matters: group_hint thresholds; prereq_hint none; difficulty_hint two; confusable_with sec10-F15 and sec10-F01.
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-hi-x:hawaii-department-of-transportation-hdot:handbook:pdf-0052]

FACT_ID: sec10-R02 | anchor: A02
Form SR twenty-one is filed as evidence of insurance after a crash, while form SR twenty-two is filed after a conviction and proof must be maintained for three years [A02].
Why it matters: group_hint filings; prereq_hint none; difficulty_hint two; confusable_with sec10-F09 and sec10-F10.
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-hi-x:hawaii-department-of-transportation-hdot:handbook:pdf-0053]

FACT_ID: sec10-R03 | anchor: A03
Liability coverage pays twenty thousand dollars per person and forty thousand dollars per accident for bodily injury, while property damage coverage is ten thousand dollars per accident [A03].
Why it matters: group_hint coverages; prereq_hint none; difficulty_hint two; confusable_with sec10-F14 and sec10-F13.
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-hi-x:hawaii-department-of-transportation-hdot:handbook:pdf-0054]

FACT_ID: sec10-R04 | anchor: A03
The ten-thousand-dollar medical and rehabilitative benefit is a per-person amount, while the ten-thousand-dollar property damage liability is a per-accident amount [A03].
Why it matters: group_hint coverages; prereq_hint sec10-R03; difficulty_hint two; confusable_with sec10-F13 and sec10-F14.
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-hi-x:hawaii-department-of-transportation-hdot:handbook:pdf-0054]

FACT_ID: sec10-R05 | anchor: A01
When you hit an attended vehicle you exchange name, address, registration and license on request, while when you hit an unattended vehicle you find the owner or leave a written notice [A01].
Why it matters: group_hint crash-duties; prereq_hint none; difficulty_hint one; confusable_with sec10-F06 and sec10-F07.
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-hi-x:hawaii-department-of-transportation-hdot:handbook:pdf-0052]

FACT_ID: sec10-R06 | anchor: A02
The safety responsibility law reaches drivers through crashes with death, injury or damage over three thousand dollars, and separately through court convictions for certain vehicle offenses [A02].
Why it matters: group_hint filings; prereq_hint sec10-R02; difficulty_hint one; confusable_with sec10-F08 and sec10-F11.
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-hi-x:hawaii-department-of-transportation-hdot:handbook:pdf-0053]

FACT_ID: sec10-R07 | anchor: A03
Insurance is required of every owner of a car, bus or truck to register or operate it, while a violation of the insurance law can bring a fine up to five thousand dollars or thirty days in jail [A03].
Why it matters: group_hint penalties; prereq_hint none; difficulty_hint two; confusable_with sec10-F12 and sec10-F16.
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-hi-x:hawaii-department-of-transportation-hdot:handbook:pdf-0054]

FACT_ID: sec10-R08 | anchor: A01
The injured are kept warm and still and their bleeding is pressed directly, while passing traffic is warned by another person using flares or a flashlight [A01].
Why it matters: group_hint crash-duties; prereq_hint sec10-R05; difficulty_hint one; confusable_with sec10-F04 and sec10-F05.
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-hi-x:hawaii-department-of-transportation-hdot:handbook:pdf-0052]

FACT_ID: sec10-R09 | anchor: A03
Property damage can be sued over at any time, while bodily injury can be sued over only above the medical threshold, for loss of a body function or serious permanent disfigurement, or for death [A03].
Why it matters: group_hint thresholds; prereq_hint sec10-R01; difficulty_hint two; confusable_with sec10-F15 and sec10-F14.
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-hi-x:hawaii-department-of-transportation-hdot:handbook:pdf-0054]

FACT_ID: sec10-R10 | anchor: A03
Non-compliance with the safety responsibility law costs the driver's license by suspension [A02], while non-compliance with the insurance law can also cost the vehicle's registration certificate [A03].
Why it matters: group_hint penalties; prereq_hint sec10-R07; difficulty_hint two; confusable_with sec10-F11 and sec10-F16.
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-hi-x:hawaii-department-of-transportation-hdot:handbook:pdf-0054]
